title: There's a new category in AI video called vibe directing. And OpenArt...
description: There's a new category in AI video called vibe directing. And OpenArt just launched the product that makes it make sense. It's called Director. Most AI video feels like you're making little clips and trying to stitch them together. Five seconds here, 10 seconds there... then you try to force it into a real story. Director is different. You start with an idea, talk through the creative direction, build the characters, shape the scenes, choose the style, add voices, music, and sound... and turn it into one complete video. The crazy part? Director can generate up to a 5 minute video in one continuous piece. So instead of fighting a bunch of disconnected clips, you're actually directing a full story. It understands pacing, characters, scene structure, and consistency. And you can still edit in two ways: Keep talking to Director through chat, or go into the timeline and control the shots more precisely. That's what makes this feel less like a generator and more like a creative environment. If you make videos, ads, explainers, music videos, or literally any visual story... Director is the one I'd try. Comment "direct" and I'll send you the link to try it yourself. #ad #openartpartner
